system.description:
The pinnacle of Visceratika lets you move freely through solid rock or concrete at a brisk swimming-like pace, useful both for patrolling a domain and for infiltrating supposedly secure areas.

You must first use Bond with the Mountain, then spend a Blood Trait to move freely through stone for the rest of the scene. You may instead walk directly through a wall up to two feet thick by spending a Blood Trait without first bonding; for thicker walls, win a Physical Challenge and bid an extra Physical Trait per additional two feet (levels of Potence reduce the effective thickness). Losing the challenge leaves you stuck in the wall until freed or until you use the power to escape.
